rv.q: Irwin is a truly magical artist to witness as he effortlessly reshapes his pliant body, rearranges his expressive features and creates dozens of voices to interpret passages from the Irish author's texts.
But there are those of us for whom Beckett will, unfortunately, always be a foreign language.
The wisdom he is serving up this summer at the Irish Rep is mandatory viewing for anyone who wants to be an actor, or a clown, or a time traveler, or a human in touch with humanity.

cn.t: Bill Irwin delivers a masterful and profoundly funny performance in this beautiful solo piece drawn from Samuel Beckett's works, with critics praising the revised iteration as lovely and expertly crafted.
